notes.title: PartySaur Demo Update #2
notes.content:
Hey y'all, we have a new update for our demo! We've tweaked some things and given a bit of a "facelift" to a bunch of stuff (things are looking gorgeous if I do say so myself). Anyway, here's a list of the things we changed:

Patch Changes:

[b]VISUAL UPDATES[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Treasure Bridge[/b]
[list]
[*]   Changes to foliage placement and appearance
[*]   Adjustments to water visuals
[*]   Minor tweaks to animations of the dice and the player
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]TipTapTrike[/b]
[list]
[*]   Revised look and feel of the scene and "MechA Trikes"
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Eruption[/b]
[list]
[*]   Added a new stage
[/list]
[/list]
[b]ITEMS SYSTEM[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted chances of obtaining specific items based on each player's position on the board. These was an issue that happened on the background and didn't critically affect gameplay, but could be troublesome in the long run.
[/list]
As always, on behalf of everyone at DireGrin, we thank you for giving our game a try and hope to see you on Early Access. Remember, we are always listening to your feedback.

That's it for now. Bye y'all,
Seb.

notes.title: PartySaur Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey there! This is our first update for our Demo (Hooraay). We thank you for playing and hope you are all enjoying our game.

Patch Changes:

[b]LOCALIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Added options for text to be displayed in either English or Spanish (More languages coming at a later date).
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new input displays for clearer instructions for keyboard players.
[/list]
[b]VISUAL UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] Made some changes to scenery and illumination (Go ahead and try to spot them).
[/list]

We again thank you for the support and hope you have a great time playing with our Dino friends. We eagerly await your feedback.

As we progress in our development process, we may continue to update this demo, with our ultimate goal being a better experience for all our players.
